mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signal broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) indicates supply-side constraints that increase recession risk and inflation expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 100,000 jobs per month signals labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction starts falling below 750,000 units per month indicates housing market weakness that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when HOUST < 750.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline and CPIAUCSL rise above 2.5% signals monetary policy response to inflation, increasing market uncertainty and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption exceeding 400,000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending that drives corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when RSAFS > 400000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.
